thesis: Representations at multiple levels can be useful without settling metaphysical questions about laws or existence.

ideas.statement: Physical dependence does not imply efficient reconstruction; high-level states may answer a task better than microscopic inventories.
Finite observations cannot uniquely identify a global law without assumptions about alternatives and access.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Two sources can coincide for a thousand moments and diverge afterward.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Consistency, constructibility and physical possibility differ; probabilities need not settle intrinsic randomness.
